scope: All local raw FAA SDR CSV rows for 2023, 2024, 2025; not limited to prefiltered AMOS matches.
deduplication: Exact distinct rows use SHA-256 of parsed field/value JSON, excluding source filename/year. OperatorControlNumber and operator-scoped identifiers are separately counted; none proves a unique failure or version resolution.
numeric_validity: Finite Decimal after trim; conventional thousands commas accepted. Positive/zero/negative and fractional counted separately. Populated counters do not establish installation age, removal, healthy exposure, or follow-up.
age_attribution: For PartNumber matches, target-age evidence must come from PartTotalCycles/PartSerialNumber; for ComponentPartNumber matches, use ComponentTotalCycles/ComponentSerialNumber. AircraftTotalCycles is airframe age at report, never interchangeable with target-part age. Since-code values are preserved as uninterpreted categorical counts.
keyword_method: Case-insensitive whole-word regex on PartName and ComponentName only, never narratives. Nozzle includes unrelated nozzle types; boiler_or_water_heater includes WATER HEATER; oven includes OVENS. Heuristic classes, not interchangeable PN labels.
